implication: Regulation 31(4) disclosures trigger when a person acquires 25% or more shares (or crosses 5%, 10%, 15%, 20%, 25%, 50%, or 75% thresholds), necessitating contemporaneous public disclosure and board notification—a critical gating mechanism for hostile moves and governance.

framework.ref: SEBI (Substantial Acquisition of Shares and Takeovers) Regulations, 2011 — Regulation 31(4)
framework.note: Central: Mandates contemporaneous disclosure to stock exchange and board on crossing 5%, 10%, 15%, 20%, 25%, 50%, 75% shareholding thresholds.

framework.ref: SEBI Takeover Code, 2011 — Regulation 2 et seq.
framework.note: Central: Defines 'acquirer', 'substantial acquisition', 'takeover bid' and triggers for mandatory open offer at 26% threshold (post-amendment).
Procedural: Disclosure obligations flow through company board; may affect CSR applicability post-acquisition.

framework.ref: Listing Agreement / Stock Exchange Rules (NSE — Chapter IV)
framework.note: Central: NSE listing rules mandate continuous disclosure of material information and shareholding changes.
Central: Pre-disclosure insider trading restrictions apply to acquirer and connected persons during acquisition window.

framework.ref: SEBI (Listing Obligations and Disclosure Requirements) Regulations, 2015 — Regulation 30
framework.note: Central: Company must disclose material information (including substantial shareholding change) within 30 minutes of NSE disclosure.
Procedural: If acquirer is non-resident, FDI approval and RBI Form ODI filing required.
